tara: Heads up — after the small-page fallback change (now using 64KB buckets) long-context runs show steady VRAM growth and a TON of tiny holes in the KV shadow map on H100. Eventually we hit a mass-evict -> pager stall pattern.

dan: Oof. Can you paste the minimal repro and any logs/traces?

tara: Repro command I used: `./run_longctx.sh --model=gpt-smalltest --seq=16384 --batch=1 --kv-page-fallback=64k`
Logs snippet: 
[KV] alloc_page sz=65536 owner=slot=0x7f free_holes=324
[pager] evict cascade start seq=1423 -> stall 120s
nvidia-smi: MemUsed +0.6GB/min steady climb

lucas: I grabbed a perf trace — nvprof shows kernel-selection thrash: tiled remap kernel gets chosen repeatedly instead of the coalesce path. Excerpt: 
```
wrap_evict_kernel<<<...>>>(...) time=3.4ms
shadow_walk_kernel<<<...>>>(...) time=9.1ms
wrap_evict_kernel<<<...>>>(...) time=3.6ms
```

dan: Does this repro on MI250X or is H100 special here? :thinking:

tara: MI250X behaves differently — it coalesces 16K chunks proactively and we don't see the cascade. H100's kernel-selection heuristic seems to flip to tiled/remap when page_sz >= 64K which multiplies remap ops and fragments the shadow map.

ryan: @tara can you try forcing a 16KB fallback and enable coalescing flag to see if it's just the threshold?

tara: Quick test: `KV_PAGE_FALLBACK=16k KV_PAGE_COALESCE=1 ./run_longctx.sh ...` -> growth stops, no cascade, perf hit ~2% token throughput but stable memory. Workaround confirmed.

infra-bot: deploy: reverted kcache-smallpage-change rollout (v2 -> v1) at 2026-03-19T18:32:10Z :white_check_mark:

dan: OK we should open an issue and add a regression test that runs longctx with mixed page sizes + both HW types. Also add a metric for "kv_shadow_hole_count".

lucas: I filed GH #4789 with attached traces, nvprof output, and the exact invocations (includes H100 and MI250X captures).

tara: Plan: bisect the kernel-select change, add longctx e2e in CI (shortened but representative), land a safe fallback that forces 16k coalescing on H100 until kernel-select is fixed, and add alerting for hole count growth.

ryan: Sounds good. I can take the kernel-select bisect if you want.

tara: Thanks — assigning you for bisect. I'll draft the rollback postmortem and test harness.

dan: Keep eng-sre in the loop for any ongoing flapping; add runbooks for manual revert.

tara: Will do.
